description: This file defines the public API for stream write operations to flash memory in the Zephyr project, including context structures, initialization, read, write, erase, and progress management functions.

methods.name: stream_flash_init
methods.description: Initializes the context for stream writes to flash memory, setting up buffers, device, offset, size, and callback.

methods.name: stream_flash_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to flash in the current context.

methods.name: stream_flash_buffered_write
methods.description: Processes input data buffers for writing to flash, with optional flush to write remaining data.

methods.name: stream_flash_erase_page
methods.description: Erases the flash page corresponding to a given offset.

methods.name: stream_flash_progress_load
methods.description: Loads previous write progress from persistent storage.

methods.name: stream_flash_progress_save
methods.description: Saves current write progress to persistent storage.
